layout.guidance: Arrange regions in inspection order, preserve named lanes, and use the relay header only when it clarifies sequence.

mobile.guidance: Use one source ordered column, a labelled navigation sheet, and full width primary actions.

tablet.guidance: Use six columns and pair work with context only when both retain readable measures.

desktop.guidance: Use twelve columns with persistent navigation and at most one contextual rail.

zoom.guidance: Wrap toolbars into named groups and let dialogs approach full width without clipping.

reflow.guidance: Keep page content in one dimension and confine intentional overflow to named data regions.

square.usage: Lane panels, tables, and grouped regions.

rule.usage: Lane separation, cards, tables, and controls.

selected.usage: Current work, keyboard focus, and strong selection.

flat.usage: Default cards, panels, navigation, forms, and tables.

raised.usage: Selected records that need temporary emphasis within a lane.

overlay.usage: Dialogs and menus above the working plane.

buttons.guidance: Use result led labels, stable widths, and primary color only for the next ranked action.

states.default: Show the complete action label and current availability.
states.hover: Increase contrast without moving the button or changing its size.
states.focus: Draw the focus ring outside the button border.
states.active: Use an inset treatment with no layout shift.
states.disabled: Keep the label visible and explain the unmet condition nearby.
states.loading: Keep the action label and append a written progress state.
states.success: Name the completed handoff and expose the next useful route.
states.error: Name the failed handoff and provide a retry or safe alternative.

links.guidance: Use precise destinations, persistent prose underlines, and visible keyboard focus.

states.default: Name the destination rather than using generic link text.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline and contrast without shifting text.
states.focus: Use the same visible focus ring as controls.
states.active: Preserve the destination name through activation.
states.disabled: Render an unavailable destination as explained status text.
states.loading: Place a written loading state beside the destination.
states.success: Report successful local resolution in adjacent text.
states.error: Report failed local resolution with a recovery action.

forms.guidance: Keep purpose, labels, inputs, help, validation, and result within one vertical scan path.
forms.help: Reviewers receive the summary and the current record context.
forms.error: Choose at least one reviewer before forwarding this record.
forms.success: The record was forwarded to lane B2.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Explain what changed and what needs a decision.
inputs.guidance: Use persistent labels, calm defined borders, and reserved validation rows.

cards.title: Release notes review
cards.description: A relay card keeps owner, freshness, state, and the next decision together.
cards.guidance: Use one card per work object and avoid nesting independent decisions inside it.

panels.title: Current relay
panels.description: A bounded context panel shows what entered, what changed, and where work goes next.
panels.guidance: Align lane coordinates, state labels, and freshness into predictable ruled rows.

navigation.label: Relay workspace
navigation.guidance: Expose current location with text, a leading rule, and aria current while preserving source order.

listItems.title: Intake
listItems.description: Records waiting for a complete brief.

listItems.title: Review
listItems.description: Records that need a named decision.

listItems.title: Publish
listItems.description: Approved records waiting for their window.

dataDisplay.guidance: Use ruled columns, row headings, written states, and freshness that stays with each record.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Place wide tables in a labelled keyboard reachable scroll region and keep row identity visible.

badges.label: Draft
badges.meaning: The handoff is still being prepared

badges.label: In review
badges.meaning: A named reviewer owns the next decision

badges.label: Ready
badges.meaning: The handoff completed all required checks

badges.label: Needs attention
badges.meaning: The handoff can continue after a correction

badges.label: Blocked
badges.meaning: The handoff cannot continue without recovery

alerts.title: Review lane recovered
alerts.description: Every queued record can move forward again.

alerts.title: Two records are blocked
alerts.description: Restore missing approvals before the publish window.

alerts.title: Schedule changed
alerts.description: Three ready records now use the revised window.

states.empty: No records have entered this lane yet. Create the first handoff.
states.filteredEmpty: No records match Needs decision. Clear the active state filter.
states.error: The relay state could not be read. Retry without losing the current filter.
states.success: Every approved record reached the publish lane.
states.disabled: Forwarding is unavailable until a reviewer is assigned.
states.destructive: Removing Release notes deletes its local handoff history.

feedback.guidance: Keep state, consequence, freshness, and the next action in the object’s own lane.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every tone with a written label, symbol or border treatment, and explicit consequence.

dialogs.title: Review handoff context
dialogs.description: Inspect the release notes changes and reviewer history before returning to lane B2.
dialogs.guidance: Keep the lane coordinate, object name, and current decision visible throughout the dialog.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes this read only dialog because no pending change would be lost.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the Open handoff details button.

destructiveActions.consequence: The record and its local lane history will be removed from this workspace.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This local specimen is reversible through Restore handoff before the page changes.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the exact object, affected history, and recovery window before confirmation.

motion.guidance: Use brief axis aligned movement to preserve continuity between relay lanes and state changes.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation, scaling, smooth scrolling, and looping indicators while preserving written state.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, lists, tables, and dialogs before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep every action operable in logical source order and confine focus only while a dialog is open.
accessibility.focus: Use a high contrast external focus ring and restore focus after overlays close.
accessibility.contrast: Meet AA text contrast and 3 to 1 contrast for boundaries, focus, meaningful graphics, and states.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide at least 24 by 24 CSS pixel targets and prefer 44 pixel primary touch actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve content and operation at 200 percent text zoom and 400 percent browser zoom.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow at 320 CSS pixels except inside labelled data regions with intentional keyboard reachable overflow.
accessibility.forcedColors: Preserve lane boundaries, selection, focus, and written status when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce durable results and validation in named status or alert regions without relying on color.

productSurfaces.guidance: Use the relay header to clarify sequence, keep product language intact, and let state remain attached to its object.
